name: jupyterlab
description: JupyterLab is a web-based interactive development environment for Jupyter notebooks, code, and data. Links Repository: https://github.com/jupyterlab/jupyterlab Wiki: https://jupyterlab.readthedocs.io/en/stable/ Docker: https://hub.docker.com/repository/docker/bgameiro/arch-jupyterlab Configuration /opt/app/data Where JupyterLab should store the Notebooks Set Up The logs contain a token needed for first login Includes several python data science libraries and CERN's ROOT for HEP.
